'''Jini''' is a ''[[damane]]'' from [[Seanchan]].

== Appearance ==
She has short yellow hair.

== Activities ==
She is with a group of soldiers in Seanchan, when they find the [[Gateway]] left by [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Aviendha]]. She is held by bonds of Air by [[Aviendha]]. Rand then tries to take Jini's ''[[a'dam]]'' off but is jolted by a shock of pain as soon as he touches it. Both Aviendha and Rand then run off back through the gateway. She is placed into the custody of the [[Seekers for Truth]] by [[Jalindin]].{{ref/book|5|32}}
